metadata.title: SE3002 Defect Management Issue Export (GitHub Issues Schema)

issues.title: [DEF-01] Critical: Protected Foreign Key Constraint Prevents Order Deletion
issues.body:
**Defect ID:** DEF-01 | **Severity:** Critical | **Priority:** P1 | **Linked Risk ID:** `PR3` | **Status:** RESOLVED

### Steps to Reproduce
1. Create a paid or canceled order containing invoice/transaction ledger children.
2. Execute direct ORM deletion (`Order.objects.all().delete()`) during database reset.

### Expected Behavior
Reset restores seeded zero-order baseline (`Orders=0, Quota Available=10`) idempotently without IntegrityError/ProtectedError.

### Actual Behavior
Django raises `ProtectedError: Cannot delete 'Order' referenced through 'Transaction.order'` / `Invoice.order`, aborting environment reset.

### Root Cause & Verified Resolution
Financial models enforce `on_delete=models.PROTECT`. Implemented reverse-topological deletion order in `scripts/reset_internal.py` (TaxRule/InvoiceLine/OrderPosition/OrderRefund/OrderPayment -> Order), verified across 2 consecutive idempotency cycles (`scripts/reset.py --verify-idempotency`).

issues.title: [DEF-02] High: Asynchronous AJAX Cart Addition Race Condition in Playwright
issues.body:
**Defect ID:** DEF-02 | **Severity:** High | **Priority:** P2 | **Linked Risk ID:** `PR4` | **Status:** RESOLVED

### Steps to Reproduce
1. Navigate to `/sqe/sqe2026/`, select quantity `1`, click `#btn-add-to-cart`.
2. Immediately click checkout link without waiting for AJAX cart completion.

### Expected Behavior
Checkout renders active cart positions cleanly every run.

### Actual Behavior
Fast browser execution outruns XHR cart creation (~150ms), landing on an empty cart page.

### Root Cause & Verified Resolution
Blind clicks ignored async XHR completion. Replaced fixed sleeps with explicit Playwright state polling (`wait_for_selector` on cart checkout container) in `tests/team/e2e/test_customer_order_flow.py` and `test_uc1_flows.py`.

issues.title: [DEF-03] Medium: Empty Orders List Table Locator Failure in Zero-State Reset
issues.body:
**Defect ID:** DEF-03 | **Severity:** Medium | **Priority:** P3 | **Linked Risk ID:** `PR3` | **Status:** RESOLVED

### Steps to Reproduce
1. Run `scripts/reset.py` so `Orders=0`.
2. Execute Playwright control-panel assertion for `table.table-orders` immediately.

### Expected Behavior
Control panel flow either seeds a prerequisite order or verifies the empty-state view cleanly.

### Actual Behavior
Strict locator `table.table-orders` times out because Pretix renders an empty-state callout instead of a table when zero orders exist.

### Root Cause & Verified Resolution
Test order coupling caused false failure after zero-state reset. Decoupled control-panel test setup in `tests/team/e2e/test_organizer_control_panel_flow.py` to create a prerequisite order via UI/API before asserting ledger rows.

issues.title: [DEF-04] High: Content Security Policy (CSP) Directives Block Axe-Core Inline Script
issues.body:
**Defect ID:** DEF-04 | **Severity:** High | **Priority:** P1 | **Linked Risk ID:** `PR6` | **Status:** RESOLVED

### Steps to Reproduce
1. Open `/control/login` in headless Chromium.
2. Call `page.add_script_tag(content=axe_js)` via Playwright.

### Expected Behavior
`axe.run()` executes WCAG 2.1 AA DOM audit.

### Actual Behavior
CSP blocks inline `<script>` injection (`EvalError`/`SecurityError` or missing `window.axe`).

### Root Cause & Verified Resolution
Added deterministic CSP bypass (`context.set_bypass_csp(True)`) solely inside the Playwright audit fixture (`tests/team/a11y/conftest.py`) while leaving production server CSP controls unweakened.

issues.title: [DEF-05] Critical: Control Panel Login Screen Fails WCAG Language, Landmark, H1, and Alt Checks
issues.body:
**Defect ID:** DEF-05 | **Severity:** Critical | **Priority:** P1 | **Linked Risk ID:** `PR6` (Compliance & Auditability) | **Status:** RESOLVED

### Steps to Reproduce
1. Audit `http://localhost:8345/control/login` using `axe-core` and Google Lighthouse.

### Expected Behavior
0 axe-core WCAG 2.1 AA violations and valid HTML semantics.

### Actual Behavior
Unpatched template failed Lighthouse Accessibility (`69/100`) and triggered axe-core findings (`html-has-lang`, `landmark-one-main`, `page-has-heading-one`, `region`, and missing logo `alt`).

### Root Cause & Verified Resolution
Durably patched `/pretix/src/pretix/control/templates/pretixcontrol/auth/base.html` and `auth/login.html` via `scripts/patch_a11y_container.py` (`lang='en'`, `<header role='banner'>`, `<main role='main'>`, `<h1 class='sr-only'>`, `alt='pretix official logo'`, `<meta name='description'>`). Verified 0 axe violations and Lighthouse Accessibility 100/100.

issues.title: [DEF-06] High: Insufficient Color Contrast and Focus Indicator on Storefront Sub-Text
issues.body:
**Defect ID:** DEF-06 | **Severity:** High | **Priority:** P2 | **Linked Risk ID:** `PR6` (WCAG 2.1 AA Compliance) | **Status:** RESOLVED

### Steps to Reproduce
1. Audit `/sqe/sqe2026/` storefront `.text-muted` / `.help-block` and `:focus-visible` states under WCAG 1.4.3 / 2.4.7.

### Expected Behavior
Contrast >= 4.5:1 and prominent focus outline rendered natively by server HTML.

### Actual Behavior
Bootstrap muted text failed contrast targets (`3.2:1` vs `4.5:1`) and focus ring lacked prominence without client injection.

### Root Cause & Verified Resolution
Added durable server-rendered `<style id='sqe-a11y-contrast-patch'>` (`.text-muted #4a4a4a`, `:focus-visible 3px solid #ff9900`) and `<meta name='description'>` in `pretixpresale/base.html` via `scripts/patch_a11y_container.py`; verified 0 storefront axe violations and Lighthouse A11y 100 / SEO 100 without runtime JS injection.

issues.title: [DEF-07] Critical: Gunicorn Worker Multiplication Causing Host OOM Crash
issues.body:
**Defect ID:** DEF-07 | **Severity:** Critical | **Priority:** P1 | **Linked Risk ID:** `PRJ1` | **Status:** RESOLVED

### Steps to Reproduce
1. Start `pretix/standalone:stable` with default worker auto-sizing (`2*cores + 1`) on multi-thread Windows Docker host.
2. Run 5-VU `k6` concurrency benchmark.

### Expected Behavior
Sustained stability under load within host RAM limits.

### Actual Behavior
Container spawned ~24 Gunicorn + Celery processes consuming >6GB RAM and causing worker OOM kills.

### Root Cause & Verified Resolution
Pinned `NUM_WORKERS=2` and `CELERY_WORKER_CONCURRENCY=1` in `docker-compose.yml`; verified 0% unexpected errors across 2,529 total requests in dual 60s 1-VU and 5-VU k6 runs.

issues.title: [DEF-08] High: Windows POSIX Signal & Fork Failure in Native mutmut Execution
issues.body:
**Defect ID:** DEF-08 | **Severity:** High | **Priority:** P2 | **Linked Risk ID:** `PRJ2` | **Status:** RESOLVED

### Steps to Reproduce
1. Run `mutmut run` inside Windows `.venv` (Python 3.11).

### Expected Behavior
Mutants compile and execute against test suite.

### Actual Behavior
`mutmut` crashes (`AttributeError: module 'os' has no attribute 'fork'` / POSIX `SIGALRM` unsupported on Win32).

### Root Cause & Verified Resolution
Built native cross-platform AST single-site mutation engine in `scripts/run_mutation_tests.py` mutating `upstream/pretix/base/scoped_business_logic.py` directly via `ast.NodeTransformer` + `compile()`, evaluating 51 mutants (`48` killed, `3` equivalent, `100.00%` effective score).

issues.title: [DEF-09] High: Idempotency Header Prefix Requirement (`X-Idempotency-Key` vs `Idempotency-Key`)
issues.body:
**Defect ID:** DEF-09 | **Severity:** High | **Priority:** P2 | **Linked Risk ID:** `PR5` | **Status:** RESOLVED

### Steps to Reproduce
1. Send two identical `POST .../orders/` requests with header `Idempotency-Key: <uuid>` instead of `X-Idempotency-Key`.

### Expected Behavior
Second request returns original order without extra quota deduction.

### Actual Behavior
Server treats `Idempotency-Key` as unrecognized header, creating two distinct orders and decrementing quota by 2.

### Root Cause & Verified Resolution
Pretix REST middleware specifically reads `X-Idempotency-Key`. Documented requirement in `openapi/team-spec.yaml` and verified both behaviors (`X-Idempotency-Key` replay vs non-`X` duplicate allocation) in `tests/team/api/test_idempotency_api.py` and `test_state_changing_recovery.py`.

issues.title: [DEF-10] High: Multi-Tenancy Scope Violation (`ScopeError`) During Direct ORM Seeding
issues.body:
**Defect ID:** DEF-10 | **Severity:** High | **Priority:** P1 | **Linked Risk ID:** `PR1` | **Status:** RESOLVED

### Steps to Reproduce
1. Run standalone Python inside `pretix_web` querying `Order.objects` or `Quota.objects` without organizer context.

### Expected Behavior
Query resolves scoped organizer/event records cleanly.

### Actual Behavior
Raises `django_scopes.exceptions.ScopeError: A scope on dimension 'organizer' needs to be active`.

### Root Cause & Verified Resolution
Pretix enforces `django-scopes` multi-tenant safety globally. Wrapped internal seed/reset operations in `with scope(organizer=org):` / `scopes_disabled()` in `scripts/seed_internal.py` and `scripts/reset_internal.py`.

issues.title: [DEF-11] Medium: Shared Quota Exhaustion Across Consecutive Integration Test Runs
issues.body:
**Defect ID:** DEF-11 | **Severity:** Medium | **Priority:** P2 | **Linked Risk ID:** `PR1` | **Status:** RESOLVED

### Steps to Reproduce
1. Run API/E2E test suites repeatedly without clearing leftover orders against finite quota (`size=10`).

### Expected Behavior
Valid test cases consistently start with full `available_number=10` capacity.

### Actual Behavior
Leftover pending/paid orders saturate quota, causing spurious `400 Not enough quota` failures in later suites.

### Root Cause & Verified Resolution
Integrated `scripts/reset.py --verify-idempotency` as pre-suite reset hook in `run_api_tests.py`, `run_e2e_tests.py`, `run_security_tests.py`, and `run_perf_dual_benchmarks.py`, plus in-test order cleanup.

issues.title: [DEF-12] Low: Missing Project Root on `sys.path` Under Direct Script / Pytest Invocation
issues.body:
**Defect ID:** DEF-12 | **Severity:** Low | **Priority:** P3 | **Linked Risk ID:** `PRJ2` | **Status:** RESOLVED

### Steps to Reproduce
1. Execute `python tests/team/api/...` or `pytest` without `PYTHONPATH=.`.

### Expected Behavior
Tests import `scripts.*`, `tools.*`, and `upstream.*` reliably.

### Actual Behavior
Raises `ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'scripts'` or `'upstream'`.

### Root Cause & Verified Resolution
Added `PROJECT_ROOT` / `BASE_DIR` insertion into `tests/team/unit/conftest.py`, `tests/team/api/conftest.py`, `tests/team/e2e/conftest.py`, `tests/team/security/conftest.py`, and runner entrypoints.
